translations.title: Multivitamin Tablet — Vitamins A, B, C, D and E (no iron)
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to supply vitamins A, B1, B2, B6, C, D and E during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, low energy during and after illness, the growth period and old age; to relieve eye dryness and night blindness; and to help prevent poor development of the bones and teeth and rickets.
translations.usage: Take it according to each product's strength and the age of the person; chewable forms are available for children. Follow the stated dosage.
translations.caution: If you take more than 5,000 IU of vitamin A a day there is a risk of birth defects, so women within the first 3 months of pregnancy or who may be pregnant should not take it. Products that contain aspartame should not be taken by people with phenylketonuria. Do not take it if you have high blood calcium, kidney disease or kidney stones, or if the child is under 12 months old.

summaryTable.Ingredient: Vitamins A, B, C, D and E (with zinc), no iron
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Nutritional supply (including vitamin A), eye dryness and night blindness, bone and teeth development
summaryTable.Why this one: A multivitamin that includes vitamin A

translations.title: Multivitamin Soft Capsule — Vitamins A, E, B and C (no iron)
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to supply vitamins A, E, B1, B2, B6 and C during physical fatigue, low energy and old age; to relieve eye dryness and night blindness; for peripheral circulation and cold hands and feet; and to help prevent skin pigmentation and bleeding of the gums and nose.
translations.usage: Children aged 8 or older and adults take one capsule once a day.
translations.caution: If you take more than 5,000 IU of vitamin A a day there is a risk of birth defects, so women within the first 3 months of pregnancy or who may be pregnant should not take it. Do not take it if you are hypersensitive to soybean oil, soy or peanuts, or if the child is under 12 months old.

summaryTable.Ingredient: Vitamins A, E, B and C, no iron
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Nutritional supply (including vitamin A), eye dryness and night blindness, peripheral circulation, prevention of pigmentation and bleeding
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Vitamin A in pregnancy; soy hypersensitivity

translations.title: Multivitamin Soft Capsule — Vitamins A, B, C and E (no iron)
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to supply vitamins A, B1, B2, B6, C and E during physical fatigue, low energy and old age; to relieve eye dryness and night blindness; for neuralgia and muscle pain; for angular cheilitis and mouth sores; to help prevent skin pigmentation and bleeding of the gums and nose; to relieve peripheral circulation problems and cold hands and feet; and to supply zinc.
translations.usage: Adults take one capsule twice a day.
translations.caution: If you take more than 5,000 IU of vitamin A a day there is a risk of birth defects, so women within the first 3 months of pregnancy or who may be pregnant should not take it. Do not take it if you are hypersensitive to soybean oil, soy or peanuts, or if the child is under 12 months old.

summaryTable.Ingredient: Vitamins A, B, C and E (with zinc), no iron
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Nutritional supply (including vitamin A), eye dryness and night blindness, neuralgia and muscle pain, mouth sores, peripheral circulation
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Vitamin A in pregnancy; soy hypersensitivity
